[15 regression] ICE when lambda is used as template argument in member function parameter type sincer15-7202
The following C++20 code causes an ICE in trunk.
```
template <auto>
struct B {};

template <class T>
struct A {
    static void f(B<[] {}>) {}
};

int main() {
    A<int>::f({});
}
```
